meta.head: c076df0fb0ea41a43f129f47007c51deae6463d7
meta.method: 6 read-only Haiku scans (non-overlapping areas) + main-thread re-verification of every retained item against HEAD. Static code review only; no runtime reproduction performed.
meta.repairBoundaryNote: BACKEND_ONLY here means Electron main-process code (no renderer change).

findings.userScenario: A zh-CN user opens Search: title 'Search', 'Close', placeholder 'Search...', scope labels ('Project name', 'Conversation title', 'User messages', 'Assistant messages'), 'Hide/Show filters', 'Save scope as default' and 'No results.' are all English. The overlay has no role=dialog/aria-modal and no Esc handler (only backdrop click closes).
evidence: SearchModal.vue contains no t( calls for UI text (grep: only scope/select logic matched)
findings.backendSupportStatus: n/a - presentation only; i18n layer (src/shared/i18n) already used by sibling modals
findings.whyRealCurrentGap: Search is a primary, always-reachable surface (sidebar button). Sibling modals (SettingsModal) use t() and role=dialog; SearchModal was never brought in line.
findings.suggestedRepairDirection: Route strings through t() with en-US/zh-CN keys; add role=dialog, aria-modal, aria-label, Esc handling and focus-on-open like SettingsModal.

findings.userScenario: Search always requests limit 50 / offset 0. A query with more than 50 hits silently shows only the first 50 with no count, 'more results' indicator or load-more control. Before the first query the result area is blank with no hint.
evidence: src/ui-app/components/SearchModal.vue:356-385 (no pagination/total UI; only 'No results.' after search)
findings.backendSupportStatus: Query params already accept limit/offset (SearchQueryParams); total-count/hasMore availability in response not verified
findings.whyRealCurrentGap: Users cannot reach older matches and are not told results are truncated - a silent data-visibility cap.
findings.suggestedRepairDirection: Add 'Load more' using offset (or at minimum a 'showing first 50' notice) plus an initial hint line. If the response lacks hasMore, fetch limit+1.

findings.userScenario: Every assistant message shows an English-only 'Raw Data' button. It opens a modal with request sequence, provider/model IDs, byte counts, SHA-256 hashes, 'Provider Error #n' and raw error codes such as RAW_DEBUG_BRIDGE_UNAVAILABLE / RAW_DEBUG_STORE_UNAVAILABLE.
findings.backendSupportStatus: Exists (window.rawGenerationDebug / rawGenerationDebugIpc) and works; the question is audience, not function
findings.whyRealCurrentGap: A debug/support surface presented as an ordinary message action in the default UI, unlocalized, with developer-grade output and raw codes when the store is unavailable.
findings.suggestedRepairDirection: Owner decision: gate behind a Settings 'Developer/Diagnostics' toggle (or move into an overflow menu); localize labels and map RAW_DEBUG_* codes to readable text.

findings.userScenario: If epoch-2 startup recovery or retry fails, the user gets a native error box titled 'Starverse startup failed' whose body is just a bare machine code. No explanation, next step, or localization; app then exits.
findings.backendSupportStatus: mainI18n infrastructure exists (electron/i18n/mainI18n.ts) but is not used here; no dialog keys exist for these
findings.whyRealCurrentGap: Fatal-path dialog is the one place a user most needs guidance; currently dead-end and untranslated. Code paths verified as reachable startup-failure branches by agent; exact trigger frequency unknown.
findings.suggestedRepairDirection: Add localized title + short explanation keyed by known recovery codes, keeping the code as a detail line.

findings.userScenario: When config.json is corrupt, the recovery prompt (a data-handling decision dialog) is hard-coded in Chinese for all users: message, detail paragraph and buttons '创建新配置' / '退出'; title is English. An English user cannot make an informed choice.
findings.whyRealCurrentGap: Verified directly at HEAD; the dialog gates whether settings/credentials are discarded, so comprehension matters.
findings.suggestedRepairDirection: Move strings into main-process locale files; keep existing semantics and tests.

findings.userScenario: The 'new chat lifecycle' block inside Settings has its own Save button, separate from the main Settings Save. Saving gives no success feedback (only errors render, as raw error.message). A user who changes it and presses only the main Save/closes the dialog loses the change with no warning.
evidence: src/ui-app/components/SettingsPanel.vue:~3018 (panel embedded); main save() at ~1330-1428 does not include it
findings.whyRealCurrentGap: Two save models in one dialog with silent success is misleading; main Save implies everything is saved.
findings.suggestedRepairDirection: Show 'Saved' feedback and/or auto-save on change; or fold into main save flow. Localize error text.

findings.userScenario: Attachments on sent messages render as a <button> card that does nothing on click (cursor-default, @click.stop) - no open, preview-enlarge or save. The card also shows developer-style metadata: 'Type: <formatId> · <confidenceLevel>', route and compatibility text.
findings.backendSupportStatus: Partial: preview retrieval exists (src/next/files/previewClient.ts); no open-file / save-as handler found in electron/ipc or src/next/files
findings.whyRealCurrentGap: Looks interactive but is inert; users cannot retrieve or inspect a file they sent. Whether this is an intended limitation is not stated in code.
findings.suggestedRepairDirection: Short term: remove the button semantics and hide raw type/confidence rows behind details. Longer term (product decision): add open/save via a new main-process handler.

findings.userScenario: Clearing/quarantining the LibreOffice runtime shows English-only window.confirm text with internal wording ('managed runtime metadata', 'DOCX PDF').
findings.whyRealCurrentGap: Verified at HEAD; other confirms in the same app use t() (CompatibleProviderSettingsPanel.vue:285).
findings.suggestedRepairDirection: Add i18n keys and plain-language copy.

findings.userScenario: Local endpoint 'Save' button is Chinese-only ('保存端点'); its failure message is English-only ('LocalEndpoint endpoint URL could not be saved locally.'). The URL is stored in renderer localStorage (separate from other settings), so it will not travel with config backup/reset.
findings.backendSupportStatus: Works; persistence location is localStorage by design (key starverse.localEndpointTextChat.url)
findings.whyRealCurrentGap: Mixed-language control on the local-model setup path. Persistence note is lower confidence and may be an intentional choice.
findings.suggestedRepairDirection: Use common.save-style key; localize error. Persistence location: confirm intent only.

findings.userScenario: In the attachment details dialog: retry button reads 'Retry file detection' in all languages; DFC options/preview failures render the backend error string verbatim; unmapped DFC diagnostic codes show as raw codes.
findings.whyRealCurrentGap: Label verified directly; raw error content depends on what backend emits at runtime.
findings.suggestedRepairDirection: Add t() key; map known DFC error/diagnostic codes to localized text with raw code as detail.

findings.userScenario: When a generation fails, the top summary bar shows 'HTTP 400 — provider_bad_request — <message>': an untranslated machine code between status and message.
findings.backendSupportStatus: Structured code/httpStatus provided; i18n mapping exists in other error views (ProviderFailureDetailsV2)
findings.whyRealCurrentGap: Verified reachable path. Code is useful for support, so impact is polish.
findings.suggestedRepairDirection: Map common codes to localized phrases; keep code as secondary text.

findings.userScenario: Scattered English-only user-visible strings: search-match nav aria-labels 'Previous match'/'Next match'; composer 'Favorite models' and 'Recent models in this session' tooltips; five OpenAI-compatible model-field placeholders; 'Rule navigation' aria-labels; 'No active conversation' title fallback.
findings.whyRealCurrentGap: locale parity test (src/shared/i18n/locales/localeKeyConsistency.test.ts) only checks key parity, so hard-coded strings are invisible to CI; this is the root cause of VPG-01/05/08/09/10/12.
findings.suggestedRepairDirection: Fix in one i18n sweep; optionally add a lint/grep guard for CJK or title/placeholder/aria-label literals in .vue.

findings.userScenario: ModelPickerDialog and DraftAttachmentDetailsDialog lack role=dialog/aria-modal on the overlay, so screen readers do not announce them as modals. Both do handle Esc.
evidence: contrast: SettingsModal.vue:93-94 and PluginManagementPanel.vue:1072-1073 set role/aria-modal
findings.whyRealCurrentGap: Inconsistent modal semantics across commonly used dialogs; focus-trap/restore not assessed statically.
findings.suggestedRepairDirection: Shared modal wrapper or attribute pass; check focus restore at runtime.

findings.userScenario: Per-provider 'Refresh' in the model picker is disabled with no tooltip/text when the provider has no catalog key; LM Studio/Ollama mode buttons are disabled with explanation only in a hover title.
findings.backendSupportStatus: Yes - disabling logic is correct; only explanation is missing
findings.whyRealCurrentGap: Verified the refresh button has no explanation; severity low because status labels exist nearby. (Agent's claim that disabled model rows lack explanation was weakened: statusLabel is rendered at ModelPickerDialog.vue:~3011.)
findings.suggestedRepairDirection: Add visible helper text or title for disabled reasons.

findings.userScenario: A user hitting a problem has no in-app way to open/export logs or diagnostics; debug flags exist only as localStorage keys (sv_debug_chat, sv_debug_reasoning). No application menu was found in electron/.
evidence: grep for Menu.buildFromTemplate/setApplicationMenu in electron/*.ts returned no matches
findings.backendSupportStatus: Diagnostics infrastructure exists; no user-facing export surface found
findings.whyRealCurrentGap: May be intentional for current release stage - retained only as a product-decision item.
findings.suggestedRepairDirection: Decide whether a 'Copy diagnostics / Open log folder' entry belongs in Settings; pairs with VPG-03.
